title: Checkout tracker
subtitle: From add to cart to completed order.
sample: Showing only the latest {{limit}} carts. Older carts in this period were not included.
rawSample: Scanning stopped after {{limit}} stored carts; older carts in this period were not included.
addsRetention: Since tracking began, up to {{hours}} h
inactivity: Abandoned after {{minutes}} min without recorded activity
funnelHint: Share of the first stage · Carts with storefront data: {{observed}} of {{total}}. Select a stage to filter sessions.
emptyFunnel: No items were added to carts in this period.
recommendationsHint: Products in the most abandoned carts, with no sales in the selected period
incomplete: Incomplete data. Select a shorter date range to see recommendations.
confidence: Small sample, limited coverage or inconclusive results.
emptyRecommendations: No product appeared in multiple abandoned carts without at least one sale in this period.
draftCreatedDetail: Code: {{code}} · Discount: {{discount}} · Products: {{products}}. Activate it in Promotions before shoppers can use it.
draftError: Could not create the promotion draft.
draftHint: The promotion is saved as a draft with a code. It does not apply discounts until you activate it in Promotions. Abandoned-cart data shows what shoppers left behind, not the right discount to offer.
winBackHint: Orders and discounts by promotion code in the selected period
orderSample: Showing only the latest {{limit}} orders. Try a shorter date range.
winBackFootnote: Order value is after discounts, excluding tax and before refunds. Using a code does not by itself prove that it generated additional sales.
exitPagesHint: Last page before leaving · Abandoned carts only
emptyExitPages: No page data yet. Page activity is collected only with analytics consent.
topProductsHint: Ranked by number of abandoned carts containing the product
emptyProducts: No abandoned carts in this period.
consent: Address, shipping, payment and order stages are inferred from cart data. The storefront collects page activity (checkout entry, order review, device and last page) only with analytics consent and deletes it 72 hours after the last visit.
noPageDataHint: Page activity is available only with analytics consent. The known stages here come from cart data.
repeatCart: Same cart from the same device within a few minutes
widgetError: This section could not load. The rest of the page still works.

stageHint.cart: Cart with an item or evidence of a later step

reason.discount: Most observed shoppers stopped before shipping. Check the product and price; the stage does not tell you why they stopped.
reason.free_shipping: Most observed shoppers stopped at shipping. Check availability, cost and delivery dates.
reason.investigate: Review the checkout flow at this step. The stage alone does not explain why shoppers stopped.
